Release Notes

This section provides release notes for the TI Cybershield Toolkit.

Version 26.00.00

Features

  • Support for F29H85x device family

  • Software-based RSA key generation with PBKDF2 password encryption for generated keys

  • PKCS#11 smart card (HSM) based RSA key generation

  • X.509 provisioning certificate configuration and generation

  • Extended OTP configuration via GUI

  • Device state detection via UART and JTAG

  • Custom binary signing

  • Debug authentication certificate generation

  • Custom SECCFG signing

  • Root of Trust (ROT) switching certificate generation

  • Prebuilt binary addon signing

  • Prebuilt RAM-based SBL

  • Prebuilt JTAG flash kernel

  • Device key provisioning via JTAG and UART

  • Device code provisioning — SECCFG, CPU1, CPU3, and HSM via UART and JTAG

  • Provisioning log parsing

  • CLI script generation

  • Device recovery certificate generation and recovery flow (CLI only)

  • Intuitive GUI with wizard-based workflow

  • CLI for full functionality

  • Comprehensive logging and diagnostics

Requirements

  • Python 3.10 or above

  • OpenSSL 3.0.2 or newer

  • Qt5 libraries for GUI functionality (see Installation Guide)

Known Issues / Limitations

Warning

SR_20 (Rev B/Rev C) OTP Keywriter Binary Not Included in Secure Binaries Addon

The secure binaries addon ships only the SR_10 (Rev A) OTP Keywriter binary. Users with Rev B or Rev C silicon must obtain the SR_20-specific OTP Keywriter binary separately from the SBL Keywriter package — it is not bundled in the addon. Contact a TI representative for more information on obtaining the correct binary for your device revision.

  • Vulnerability analysis of this tool was not scoped in this release

  • The latest out-of-box binaries are not compatible with Rev 0 / Rev A (SR_10) devices. Customers must either use an older version of TIFS or backport the latest firmware. Contact a TI representative for more information.

  • Only RSA is supported for Key Generation in the tool_name (TCSPT-72)

  • Extended OTP Needs to be manually entered instead of Custom File (TCSPT-71)

  • JTAG connection requires CCS for debug connection (to be removed in future versions)

  • UART connection may require multiple attempts on some systems

Supported Devices

  • F29H85x: All variants

Installation

See the Installation section for detailed installation instructions.
